items.title: Abimelech son of Gideon
items.charge: Slaying his seventy brethren upon one stone with silver out of the house of Baal-berith; making himself king at Shechem

items.title: Absalom
items.charge: Murder of Amnon; stealing the hearts of the men of Israel; conspiracy and rebellion against the king his father; lying with his father’s concubines before all Israel

items.title: Achan
items.charge: Israel trespassed in the accursed thing: Achan saw, coveted, took of the devoted spoil of Jericho, and hid it in his tent

items.title: Adonijah
items.charge: Exalting himself, saying, I will be king; and after his pardon, asking for Abishag the Shunammite

items.title: Agag king of the Amalekites
items.charge: The sword that made women childless; and the sworn war with Amalek from generation to generation

items.title: Ahab
items.charge: Marrying Jezebel and serving Baal above all the kings before him; letting go Ben-hadad whom the Lord appointed to destruction; selling himself to work wickedness

items.title: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
items.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord among the captives at Babylon; committing villainy in Israel and adultery with their neighbours’ wives

items.title: Ahaziah of Israel
items.charge: Sending to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, as though there were not a God in Israel

items.title: Ahaziah of Judah
items.charge: Walking in the ways of the house of Ahab, his mother being his counsellor to do wickedly; going down to Jezreel to see Joram

items.title: Ahithophel
items.charge: Treason against David; counselling Absalom to lie with his father’s concubines; asking for twelve thousand men to smite the king; suicide

items.title: Alcimus
items.charge: Slandering Judas to the king; slaying sixty Asideans under a sworn peace; pulling down the wall of the inner court

items.title: Aman, who ensnared Achiacharus
items.charge: Treachery against the man who brought him up

items.title: Amaziah
items.charge: Bringing home the gods of the children of Seir, setting them up to be his gods, and bowing down before them; threatening the prophet sent to him; provoking Israel to his hurt

items.title: Amnon
items.charge: Forcing his sister Tamar, then hating her and putting her out

items.title: Amon
items.charge: Sacrificing to all the carved images his father had made; humbling not himself as his father had humbled himself, but trespassing more and more

items.title: Ananias and Sapphira
items.charge: Vowing a possession to the Lord, keeping back part of the price, and lying to the Holy Ghost about it

items.title: Andronicus
items.charge: Murder of Onias the high priest under a sworn assurance

items.title: Antiochus Epiphanes
items.charge: Defiling the temple; forbidding the law; murdering the faithful

items.title: Apollonius
items.charge: Falling upon Jerusalem on the Sabbath under a pretence of peace; slaying a great multitude; taking women and children captive

items.title: Athaliah
items.charge: Destroying all the seed royal of the house of Judah to reign herself; crying treason when the rightful king was crowned

items.title: Baanah and Rechab
items.charge: Murder of Ish-bosheth on his bed at noon, and carrying his head to David for a reward

items.title: Baasha
items.charge: Walking in the way of Jeroboam after being exalted out of the dust to destroy Jeroboam’s house

items.title: Balaam
items.charge: Divination for hire; counselling Balak to make Israel curse itself through the women of Moab

items.title: Belshazzar
items.charge: Drinking wine from the gold and silver vessels taken out of the temple of the house of God at Jerusalem, with his princes, his wives, and his concubines, and praising the gods of gold, silver, brass, iron, wood, and stone; lifting himself up against the Lord of heaven, having known how his father was humbled

items.title: Ben-hadad and the Syrians at Aphek
items.charge: Saying, the Lord is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys

items.title: Bigthan and Teresh
items.charge: Two of the king’s chamberlains, of those which kept the door, being wroth and seeking to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus

items.title: Daniel’s accusers
items.charge: Seeking occasion against Daniel and finding none; procuring a decree by the law of the Medes and Persians that no man petition any god or man for thirty days save the king, to take him in the law of his God; assembling to find him praying and pressing the king to cast him to the lions

items.title: Eglon king of Moab
items.charge: Possessing the city of palm trees and holding Israel in servitude eighteen years

items.title: Eli and his sons
items.charge: Sons of Belial in the priest’s office, strong-arming the offering of the Lord and lying with the women at the tabernacle door; and a father who honoured his sons above the Lord

items.title: Er and Onan
items.charge: Er: wickedness in the sight of the Lord. Onan: refusing to raise up seed to his brother

items.title: Goliath of Gath
items.charge: Defying the armies of the living God, morning and evening, forty days

items.title: Haman the Agagite
items.charge: Thinking scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone, and seeking to destroy all the Jews throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus; offering ten thousand talents of silver for their destruction; making a gallows fifty cubits high for Mordecai

items.title: Hananiah the son of Azur
items.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord, and breaking the yoke from off Jeremiah’s neck before the priests and all the people

items.title: Herod Agrippa
items.charge: Accepting worship due to God alone

items.title: Holofernes
items.charge: Making Nebuchadnezzar a god; blasphemy against the God of Israel; lust and drunkenness

items.title: Jabin and Sisera
items.charge: Mightily oppressing Israel twenty years with nine hundred chariots of iron

items.title: James the brother of John
items.charge: Killed with the sword by Herod, to please the people

items.title: Jehoram of Judah
items.charge: Slaying all his brethren with the sword as soon as he was strengthened; walking in the way of the house of Ahab, for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife; making high places and compelling Judah to fornication

items.title: Jezebel
items.charge: Cutting off the prophets of the Lord; feeding eight hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the groves at her table; whoredoms and witchcrafts

items.title: Jezebel and Naboth’s vineyard
items.charge: Letters in the king’s name under the king’s seal; a fast, two sons of Belial, and a stoning, to take a man’s inheritance

items.title: Jezebel of Thyatira
items.charge: Calling herself a prophetess; teaching the servants of God to commit fornication and eat things sacrificed to idols

items.title: Joab
items.charge: Shedding the blood of war in peace: Abner in the gate of Hebron, and Amasa with a kiss

items.title: Joash of Judah
items.charge: Hearkening to the princes after Jehoiada’s death; leaving the house of the Lord to serve groves and idols; stoning Zechariah the son of Jehoiada in the court of the house of the Lord

items.title: Johanan and the remnant that went down to Egypt
items.charge: Asking Jeremiah to pray for the way wherein they should walk, swearing to obey the voice of the Lord whether it were good or evil, and then calling the prophet a liar and going into Egypt against the commandment; burning incense to the queen of heaven in the land of Egypt

items.title: John the Baptist
items.charge: Telling a king it is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife

items.title: Josiah at Megiddo
items.charge: Going out against Necho king of Egypt who had no quarrel with him; hearkening not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God; disguising himself to fight

items.title: Judas Iscariot
items.charge: Theft from the common purse; betraying innocent blood for thirty pieces of silver

items.title: Judas’ soldiers with idol tokens under their coats
items.charge: Carrying things consecrated to idols into battle

items.title: King Saul
items.charge: Offering the burnt offering himself at Gilgal; sparing Agag and the best of the spoil; and stubbornness, which is as iniquity and idolatry

items.title: Korah, Dathan, and Abiram
items.charge: Rebellion against the men the Lord chose; seeking the priesthood also

items.title: Lot’s wife
items.charge: Looking back toward Sodom against the angel’s command

items.title: Lysimachus
items.charge: Sacrilege: robbing the temple with Menelaus’ consent

items.title: Menelaus
items.charge: Buying the priesthood over Jason; stealing the temple vessels; procuring the murder of Onias; bribing his way past the king’s judgment

items.title: Nabal
items.charge: Railing on the Lord’s anointed and his men who had been a wall to his shepherds; who is David?

items.title: Nadab and Abihu
items.charge: Offering strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not

items.title: Nicanor
items.charge: Blasphemy against the temple; breaking covenant with Judas; resolving to attack on the Sabbath

items.title: Nineveh under Nahum
items.charge: A bloody city, full of lies and robbery, whose prey departeth not; the dwelling of the lions that filled his holes with prey; the wicked counsellor that imagineth evil against the Lord

items.title: Pelatiah and the princes at the east gate
items.charge: Devising mischief and giving wicked counsel in the city: it is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh

items.title: Samson
items.charge: Lusting after Philistine women: a wife at Timnath against his parents’ counsel, a harlot at Gaza, and Delilah, to whom he told all his heart

items.title: Saul and the witch of Endor
items.charge: Seeking a woman with a familiar spirit after he had himself put them out of the land

items.title: Saul’s house and the Gibeonites
items.charge: Breaking the oath Israel sware to the Gibeonites by slaying them in zeal for Israel and Judah

items.title: Sennacherib and Rabshakeh
items.charge: Reproaching the living God; setting the Holy One of Israel among the gods of the nations that could not save

items.title: Sheba son of Bichri
items.charge: Insurrection: we have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse

items.title: Shechem son of Hamor
items.charge: Taking Dinah and defiling her; then seeking to marry into the house he had wronged and make the two peoples one

items.title: Shimei son of Gera
items.charge: Cursing the king and casting stones at him: come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial

items.title: Sihon and Og
items.charge: Refusing Israel passage on the king’s highway and coming out to battle against them

items.title: Sodom and Gomorrah
items.charge: Pride, fulness of bread, abundance of idleness, and abomination; the whole city demanding the strangers

items.title: The Amalekite who claimed to kill Saul
items.charge: Claiming to have slain the Lord’s anointed, and bringing his crown for a reward

items.title: The blasphemer in the camp
items.charge: Blaspheming the Name of the Lord, and cursing, in a quarrel

items.title: The Chaldeans who accused the Jews
items.charge: Coming near and accusing the Jews to the king, that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego regarded not the king, served not his gods, nor worshipped the golden image, to have them cast into the furnace for keeping the second commandment

items.title: The elders with idols in the temple (Ezekiel 8)
items.charge: The image of jealousy at the gate; seventy ancients with censers before creeping things and idols portrayed on the wall in the dark, saying, the Lord seeth us not; women weeping for Tammuz; twenty-five men with their backs to the temple worshipping the sun toward the east

items.title: The five kings at Makkedah
items.charge: Confederating against Gibeon for making peace with Israel

items.title: The generation of the Flood
items.charge: Despising the commandments; corruption and violence filling the earth after the sons of God mixed with the nations

items.title: The generation that died in the wilderness
items.charge: Tempting the Lord ten times; unbelief at Kadesh-barnea; a captain to return into Egypt

items.title: The Hellenizers who forsook the holy covenant
items.charge: Covenanting with the heathen; removing circumcision; profaning the Sabbath; sacrificing to idols

items.title: The Jew who sacrificed at Modin
items.charge: Sacrificing on the heathen altar at the king’s command

items.title: The lord on whose hand the king leaned
items.charge: Doubting the word of the Lord by Elisha in the famine of Samaria: if the Lord would make windows in heaven, might this thing be?

items.title: The man gathering sticks on the Sabbath
items.charge: Gathering sticks on the Sabbath day to kindle a fire: the presumptuous sin

items.title: The man of God from Judah
items.charge: Turning back to eat bread and drink water at Bethel against the word of the Lord, on the word of a prophet who lied

items.title: The man who refused the prophetic command
items.charge: Refusing to smite the prophet when commanded in the word of the Lord

items.title: The men of Beth-shemesh
items.charge: Looking into the ark of the Lord

items.title: The men of Gibeah, and Benjamin
items.charge: Sons of Belial demanding the man; the gang rape and death of his concubine; and a tribe that would not deliver up the guilty

items.title: The men of Joppa
items.charge: Drowning two hundred of the Jews that dwelt among them, under a pretence of peace

items.title: The men of Succoth and Penuel
items.charge: Refusing bread to the army of the Lord, faint yet pursuing, and upbraiding them with it

items.title: The Midianites, in the matter of Peor
items.charge: Beguiling Israel with their wiles into fornication and the worship of Baal-peor

items.title: The penitent thief
items.charge: Robbery, under sentence of crucifixion

items.title: The priests of Bel
items.charge: Deceiving the king and the people with an idol that seemed to eat

items.title: The prince of Tyre
items.charge: Saying, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; setting his heart as the heart of God because of the riches gotten by his wisdom and his traffick

items.title: The prophets of Baal at Carmel
items.charge: Prophesying in the name of Baal and eating at Jezebel’s table; crying from morning to noon to a god that could not answer

items.title: The two elders who accused Susanna
items.charge: Attempted adultery by extortion; false witness against an innocent woman

items.title: Timotheus
items.charge: Gathering the heathen to root out the Jews; a second campaign after being once spared

items.title: Uzzah and the ark
items.charge: Putting forth his hand to the ark of God, which was carried on a new cart and not on the shoulders of the Levites

items.title: Zimri
items.charge: Conspiring against his master Elah as he drank himself drunk; slaying all the house of Baasha; seven days on the throne

items.title: Zimri and Cozbi
items.charge: Bringing a Midianite woman into the camp in the sight of the congregation, while the plague ran
